source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 586 captures dataTransfer.dropEffect before setting it to none during validation. After target checks it chooses copy or move from that captured system value. The folder path additionally considers same-server move rules. Address-book code removes the ctrlKey-based override so it also follows the platform effect. Do not infer a platform drag operation from one modifier key or read dropEffect after overwriting it. No native drag operation was performed.
title: Preserve the system drop effect before using a rejected-drop default
